description: Using data from the Uber app, this plugin shows ride tracking and car information in a Smartspacer Target. Know when your driver will arrive, their registration, and their image for verification.
changelog:
- Works with Uber's current trip notifications (Android 16 Live Updates)
- Still reads Uber's older notification layout when available
- Shows only the notification that looks like your active trip
- Falls back to a simple text card if the trip card cannot be drawn
